imageAlts: Posters advertising RPI plaster a white wall behind a series of white columns and silver poles.
A photo of the EMPAC space on RPI's campus sits in a transluscent envelope on a grey surface.
A red and white RPI tote bag is slung across the back of an orange plastic chair.
Collection of various Instagram stories arranged in a grid layout.
RPI branded book lying on a blue surface
RPI logo on a silver caliper
A polished, red F1 car races to the left with RPI emblazoned on the side.
A large, red RPI banner hangs on a brutalist building
Black and white RPI blogo shown on an old school monitor.
Computer on a wood desk showing the RPI homepage with the EMPAC center
RPI posters depicting the nature on campus, a cello player, and the IBM quantum computer adorn a cement wall dappled in sunshine.
A 26/27 Academic School Year calendar with a red RPI seal sticker paperclipped to the front
RPI and IBM co-branding beside the IBM quantum computer on RPI's campus
In a dark cement alcove outdoors, a post for an eco-futurism fashion show sits prominently.
Spiral-bound brochure displaying a photo of RPI campus and two columns of text.
Hand holding a phone that shows the mobile RPI homepage and the EMPAC center against a gray background
Two promotional posters mounted on brick wall in building corridor advertising a chemistry symposium.
Collection of red and white printed RPI brochures spread on a table.
Postage stamps in red, yellow, blue, and black
A photo of an RPI-branded floppy disk on top of pavement and a grate
